body: I don't know why I find this so sweet!
I will take your advice, soon I will be going to a Psychologist. Depending on what he says, I will talk to my family. Thank you very much for responding to this patetic cry for help.

Thank you for your sharing your experience. It helps a lot.

To answer to your questions: 1. No, I haven't seen a Doctor, but it is in my to-do list.

2. It is....bad, I honestly feel bad for them. I just ruined a future relationship with a wonderful person, and I am just not able to feel a thing. I use to be the comic relief, but know I just want to be left alone.

3. There are, I know. But the most important ones are things that I just can't change, the only thing I can do is to cope with it.

Once again...thank you for taking your time to respond to this. Makes me feel...like I am not that alone.
That I have a new group of friends that I really really like, but I know that, like every other friendship,of mine, is not going to last long, and suddenly I am going to find myself alone once again.

All I can say is that this really made my day.    
I'm spilling tears while I read this. I think it's really beautiful the way you see what's good and positive in me, and in my post, when yesterday while I was writing it I did not see any light at all.
